description: Generic domain pack: system-level defaults only. Applies to every request regardless of domain; never adds business-specific metrics.

knownAmbiguities.question: Which time range should the analysis cover?
knownAmbiguities.whyNeeded: The request does not specify a time window; trend and level results depend on it.

knownAmbiguities.question: Compared to which period or baseline?
knownAmbiguities.whyNeeded: A comparison request needs a reference period to be meaningful.

knownAmbiguities.question: Which business subject or dataset should this analysis target?
knownAmbiguities.whyNeeded: Without a subject the analysis cannot pick a data source or scope.

knownAmbiguities.question: What business decision should this analysis support?
knownAmbiguities.whyNeeded: The objective determines the metrics, dimensions and plan shape.
